name: Mitsuba 3
role: Python physically based path tracer with scalar CPU variants, fixed spp and seed, built-in scenes
summary: Research renderer pip-installable as a wheel (mitsuba plus drjit). Scenes are Python dicts or XML; mi.render takes spp and seed and returns a float image. Variants include scalar_rgb, spectral and differentiable ones; LLVM and Metal variants exist but the LLVM probe failed on the fixture machine.
use_when: A pip-installable, seed-and-spp-controlled path tracer for stills or look references
Spectral or differentiable rendering from Python
avoid_when: Rigged or animated scenes, meshes and the compositor: blender
Bitwise-reproducible pixels: not shown, see the evidence

install.macos: python3 -m venv venv && venv/bin/pip install mitsuba==3.9.1 numpy==2.5.5

notes: 2026-11-27: the lead said the licence needed verifying; the 3.9.1 wheel ships a BSD-3 licence file and a BSD classifier. The lead's 'uv pip install' was replaced by pip in a venv. numpy is not a dependency of the wheel but the Python array route needs it.
2026-11-27: on macOS arm64 the llvm_ad_* variants printed 'LLVM API initialization failed' (no LLVM library found); scalar_rgb works and renders multi-threaded.

assessment.rationale: PyPI 3.9.1 (2026-08-07) installs in a venv on macOS arm64 Python 3.12 with drjit 1.5.0; BSD-3 per the wheel licence. It adds a scriptable path tracer with explicit spp and seed that neither blender (GUI-app route, scene files) nor pov-ray (text CSG) covers. Reproducibility is weaker than the lead implied: see evidence.

evidence.result: scalar_rgb Cornell box 96x96, 16 spp, seed 7 renders with red left and dim green right walls; seed changes pixels, 256 spp is less noisy. FAILED: same seed is not bitwise identical (in process or across processes; max abs diff ~3e-8) and the green-wall ratio check (>2x) failed (0.0588 vs 0.05).
evidence.scope: scalar_rgb only, macOS arm64, Python 3.12; seeded stats and ~1e-8 repeatability, not bitwise determinism; no LLVM, spectral, differentiable, animation or large scenes.
